records.name: SAS Missing Value Conditional Comparison Rules
records.equality_behavior: Evaluates to numeric value smaller than all numbers
records.truthiness: Falsy (0 and missing values evaluate to False; non-zero numeric is True)
records.ordering_behavior: Lowest possible value in ASC sort
silent_gotchas: In SAS: `if x < 10 then` branches execute for missing values!
In SAS: `if x > . then` is the standard idiom to check for valid non-missing numbers
migration_preservation_rules: Replace SAS `if x < 10` with Python `if x is not None and x < 10`

records.name: SQL Three-Valued Logic Evaluation Rules
records.equality_behavior: NULL = NULL is UNKNOWN; NULL <> NULL is UNKNOWN
records.truthiness: UNKNOWN is treated as false in WHERE, HAVING, and CHECK constraints (except inverse checks)
records.ordering_behavior: NULLS LAST in Postgres ASC, NULLS FIRST in Oracle ASC
silent_gotchas: SELECT * WHERE x = NULL returns 0 rows; must use IS NULL
CASE WHEN NULL THEN 'a' ELSE 'b' END executes the ELSE branch
migration_preservation_rules: In Python expressions, translate `IS NULL` to `x is None` and `IS NOT NULL` to `x is not None`

records.name: Python None Comparison and Truthiness Rules
records.equality_behavior: None == None is True; None != None is False
silent_gotchas: `x == None` is discouraged by PEP 8; should use `x is None`
migration_preservation_rules: Guard against TypeError when migrating relational comparisons on nullable fields

records.name: JavaScript null and undefined Comparison Rules
records.equality_behavior: null == undefined (true); null === undefined (false); null == 0 (false); undefined == 0 (false)
records.ordering_behavior: null converts to 0; undefined converts to NaN
records.aggregation_behavior: Skipped or coerced depending on operation
migration_preservation_rules: Use strict equality === or optional chaining (?.)
